summary: Verified red-color display of early_leave_credit entries and removal of auto-generated 'Crédito automático' observation across PDF, Excel and frontend. 7/7 pytest tests PASSED + Playwright UI verification on /reports for user teste@email.com / month 6 2026 (admin table view).
critical_code_review_comments: excel_report.py:138-144 — payment column logic uses 'any outside_residence_zone' flag for the whole day, but credit entries propagate outside_residence_zone=False even when real entries are outside zone. Confirmed via this iteration's payload (routes/time_entries.py L1742-1748 now includes both flags). Not blocking.

pdf_report.py:218-226 — when has_credit=True ALL entry labels are wrapped in a single Paragraph so even non-credit entries (08:00-13:00, 14:00-16:00) become Paragraph cells; this works but means alignment differs slightly between days with and without credit. Cosmetic only.

Reports.jsx admin compact table (L1010-1029) intentionally omits observations — confirmed real user obs 'teste E2E' is therefore not visible in admin table view; it is shown only in the card view (L700-704). User flow OK but worth documenting in PRD if users expect to see obs in admin table.
test_credentials: teste@email.com / Admin123! (user_id c145d94b-bb5f-4fe1-b05d-6fa1034db968) — has 3 entries on 2026-06-25 (08:00-13:00 normal, 14:00-16:00 normal+'teste E2E' obs, 16:00-17:00 credit).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed in db.time_entries for 2026-06-25.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest /app/backend/tests/test_early_leave_credit_red_display.py covers: (1) monthly-detailed exposes is_early_leave_credit=true on the credit entry and false on the others; (2) monthly-pdf returns 200 with %PDF header, contains all 3 time ranges (08:00-13:00, 14:00-16:00, 16:00-17:00), does NOT contain 'Crédito automático' or 'saída antecipada por ordem da empresa', does contain real user obs 'teste E2E', and has a red 'rg' color op (~0.86 0.15 0.15) in a content stream (pypdf decoded); (3) monthly Excel (/api/time-entries/reports/excel?start_date=2026-06-01&end_date=2026-06-30) — row for day 25 has cells with rgb FFDC2626 + bold=True on the credit pair (the credit entry was rendered in columns 7,8 with values 16:00 and 17:00; reading is filtered by font.color.type=='rgb' to skip default theme cells); (4) regression: no other day in June 2026 has is_early_leave_credit=true. Playwright run logged in on /reports, set month=6 year=2026 + clicked Atualizar, scrolled to Dia 25 row → confirmed '15:00–16:00' (UTC view of 16:00-17:00 +01:00) rendered with class text-red-400 + tooltip 'Crédito de horas por ordem da empresa', and 'Crédito automático' string was absent from page HTML. Admin compact table view does not render observations by design.
rca of the issue: N/A — review request; no bug found. Implementation matches spec: backend payload exposes is_early_leave_credit; PDF/Excel render the credit cell in #dc2626 bold; auto observation 'Crédito automático — saída antecipada por ordem da empresa autorizada por X' is stripped in _extrair_localizacao_e_limpar_obs and hidden in Reports.jsx via {!isCredit && entry.observations}.
